theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_variation_liminf_density_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclidean N), IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → ⨆ i, ν i W ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n μ x θ ∧ θ ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ c r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → liminf (fun i ↦ ν i (closedBall x ρ)) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
